d: Long, flowing teal hair with choppy bangs is partially covered by a white cap featuring a glowing neon green skull emblem. The golden-yellow eyes have a neutral expression on a face with the apparent maturity of a young teenager. A slender build is dressed in a white oversized lab coat over a black t-shirt emblazoned with a large neon green skull, complemented by a metallic grey neck guard and black gloves. Accessories include a white cap with a black headset integrated over the ears and a handheld electronic device.
